questions.key_step: Read a three-boundary region and pick x-slicing with three ranges; surds must cancel.
questions.justification: Three boundaries, two parabolas and a line, three integrals with cancelling surds; one slip changes m+n and no options.

questions.key_step: Break the min at x=4: triangle plus one parabola integral.
questions.justification: Routine: one crossing, a triangle and one polynomial integral.

questions.key_step: Segment with central angle pi/2+phi and matching the sin^-1 format.
questions.justification: Segment area needs the central angle and sine, then matching coprime alpha/beta in the given form.

questions.key_step: Switch of the lower curve at x=2.
questions.justification: One crossing and two elementary integrals.

questions.key_step: Chord equation, area (a+b)^3/6, triangle area, then AM-GM.
questions.justification: Parameterised area ratio plus an inequality; two chapters but each step standard.

questions.key_step: Reduce the area to (2/3)k^2/(k^2+4)^2 and maximise over both signs of k.
questions.justification: Parametric area then calculus; both signs of k must be remembered.

questions.key_step: Read the circle from an inequality and split at y=1.
questions.justification: Circle, parabola and line combined; the circle condition is binding only for y<1.

questions.key_step: Greatest-integer step in min; the line bounds for x>=1.
questions.justification: Piecewise reading of a step function but only simple integrals.

questions.key_step: Recover y=1-x^2 and see the lens as quarter-disc minus a corner.
questions.justification: Short geometric area, one standard integral.

questions.key_step: Triangles on the axis around the tangent and line.
questions.justification: Tangent plus intersection points and triangle decomposition needing care with signs.

questions.key_step: Line through the circle centre removes an eighth of the disc.
questions.justification: Routine strip integral plus recognising the eighth-sector.
